summary: First-party research verified Myanmar national SLRD and GAD land-administration pointers, but no Hpa-An-local public parcel viewer/API or safe parcel geometry was obtained. SLRD direct requests returned Cloudflare challenges and Survey Department timed out. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Burmese discovery queries, actual text, outcomes, and URLs are recorded in city-5910-hpa-an.json. Results establish national agency pointers and non-cadastral Hpa-an mapping, not a local parcel service.
requestOutcomes: Five routes were attempted: SLRD branch and landing GETs returned HTTP 403 challenges; Survey Department timed out; GAD land-division and the Burmese Hpa-an flood-map page returned HTTP 200 HTML. No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private tokens, unsafe fields, parcel IDs, or geometry were requested or retained.
scopeLimits: National SLRD/GAD custody is not treated as local Hpa-An registry evidence; registryFound remains null.
No public parcel API, viewer configuration, schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, or bounded geometry response was verified.
No exact WUP-point hit or miss was obtained; the exact point remains [16.8771381453168, 97.6398520408478] in latitude/longitude order.
Cloudflare challenges, timeout, general-agency pages, census material, and a flood map are access/scope limitations, not citywide absence evidence.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
credentials, private tokens and personal data
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. A future retained sample must contain exactly one stable native ID in properties and keep source field mapping in this review.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No usable public parcel geometry service was reached. No hit/miss inference was made.
